status: not implemented; new original-training data lead identified

new_sources.published_input: OPPO Reno8 bedside stereo 48000 Hz phone recordings (MP3), with synchronized PSG-derived sleep-stage CSVs and event annotations; 50 subjects, over 400 hours

actual_access_probe.method: GET, anonymous, public web-client endpoint inspected in its own JavaScript

new_sources.decision_change: A newly identified licensed corpus contains actual bedside-phone audio plus stage labels, rather than wrist/EEG inputs or only event clips. It is a concrete original-training lead, not an available fitted estimator.
new_sources.remaining_prerequisite: The initial endpoint denial below is superseded as a general access concern by the successful anonymous public-file follow-up. Validate the actual release waveform/label contract and partial coverage, then original training and useful held-out ambient-input behavior are still required before Android integration.

public_file_followup.initial_denial_scope: The recorded dataset/details endpoint returned70001. That response did not establish a browser or individual-file download restriction. The initial file_inventory_verified=false fields describe the earlier probe, not current access.

file_list.expand: Use returned folder.path with the same public endpoint; frontend uses lastIndex=0 initially and last returned index+1 for additional pages.

helper.name: osa_data_eng.py
helper.timebase: Absolute stage CSV column1 hh:mm:ss.ms; hours below12 add24; subtract the same subject annotation.record_start. Source comment identifies that value as audio alignment. No scaling or guessed shift is supplied.
helper.input: Phone waveform loaded with librosa.load(sr=None), default mono.

public_file_followup.actual_released_phone_format: Three bounded4096-byte HTTP206 header ranges establish PCM16 mono8000Hz,16000bytes/second. This differs from the paper's original stereo48k phone recording description. No upsampling was used or high-frequency content invented.
public_file_followup.limits: The WAV headers do not embed a start clock. The supplied annotation/helper offset is author provenance, not independent synchronization proof. Full phone files were not downloaded or rehashed. Labels outside actual PCM and blank rows must remain missing; the release cannot be called complete-night coverage.
public_file_followup.protocol: 2026-10-31-phone-stage-pilot-protocol.json; frozen before any fit/inference. TRAIN01-30, validation31-40, untouched test41-50.

new_sources.published_method: Ambient PSG-Audio downsampled to 16 kHz; local normalization, 50 Hz high-pass and pre-emphasis; frozen HuBERT-Base with trained attention/pooling and two-layer Wake/NREM/REM classifier; 30-second input or 90-second context targeting its center 30 seconds; participant-level split
new_sources.remaining_prerequisite: A reusable release of the fitted attention/classifier parameters and exact preprocessing, or original training with synchronized licensed ambient audio. Generic HuBERT embeddings are not sleep-stage probabilities. This three-class method cannot separately supply Light and Deep.

original_acoustic_pilot_followup.public_dataset_access: resolved; anonymous public file-tree and bounded 206 downloads succeeded
original_acoustic_pilot_followup.fit: one fixed original 243-feature RF128 fit, TRAIN01-30 (28 supported phone subjects), validation31-40, frozen TEST41-50 once
original_acoustic_pilot_followup.decision: Reject this fitted prototype for Android staging despite the modest predeclared gate passing. Overall and probability errors are worse than the natural-TRAIN baselines; Deep evaluation is inadequate (validation2/test1). F049 remains Missing.
original_acoustic_pilot_followup.remaining_gate: A different frozen trained ambient-phone method must show useful participant-held-out discrimination and probability behavior with adequate class support on fresh evaluation subjects; preserve real capture timing/gaps. No access or clinical-certification gate is asserted.
